name: @w6w-apps/pipedrive
description: Manage Pipedrive deals, persons, organizations, activities, notes and leads.

w6w.longDescription:
Pipedrive brings core CRM data into a workflow — deals, people, organizations, activities, notes and leads — across the six resources a sales process touches most. Deal actions create, read, update and delete deals, with a dedicated bulk-read action for pulling many at once, while person and organization actions manage the contacts and companies behind those deals.

Activity and note actions let a workflow log a scheduled task or a piece of context against a deal or contact, and a lead action creates a new lead before it has been qualified into a full deal. The app authenticates either with a personal API token for a single Pipedrive account or with OAuth2 for a broader integration, both verified against the same lightweight "who am I" call.

This is a focused CRUD surface on Pipedrive's most-used resources — search endpoints, file attachments and Pipedrive's own webhook triggers are deliberately left out, keeping the action set to the operations a sales workflow reaches for most often.
